name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: Short hint text on hover and keyboard focus.

css.content:
/* Radix tooltip content. The legacy .tip-wrap/.tip CSS-only tooltip still works. */
.tooltip { z-index: var(--z-toast); padding: var(--s1) var(--s3); background: var(--surface); color: var(--surface-text); font-size: var(--text-xs); max-width: 280px; animation: dialog-fade var(--fast) var(--ease); }

a11y: Shows on hover and on keyboard focus; the trigger gets aria-describedby while it is open.
Escape dismisses it; it stays open while the pointer is over it.
Never the only place for essential information: touch users do not get hover.

props.name: content
props.description: The text shown. Keep it short; it repeats or extends a label and must never hold essential information alone.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger element. It receives aria-describedby when open.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the trigger the tooltip appears on: `top` (default), `right`, `bottom` or `left`.

props.name: delayDuration
props.description: Milliseconds to wait before showing on hover. Defaults to the `TooltipProvider` value.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the tooltip is open when controlled. Pair with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the tooltip starts open when uncontrolled. Default false.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the new open state when the tooltip shows or hides.

usage: import {Button, Tooltip, TooltipProvider} from '@monoline/react';

source.content:
export {Tooltip, TooltipProvider, TooltipContent} from './tooltip';
